subject: Literature
title: Bernardine Evaristo and Girl, Woman, Other
description: A short lesson to help you apply Bernardine Evaristo and Girl, Woman, Other.

hook.text: Bernardine Evaristo became the first Black woman to win the Booker Prize, sharing it with Margaret Atwood in 2019.

buildup.text: Girl, Woman, Other weaves twelve interconnected stories of Black British women across generations and identities.

discovery.text: The novel uses a fluid, unpunctuated prose style that mirrors the flowing, overlapping nature of its characters' lives.

twist.text: Evaristo published eight books over decades before winning the Booker, proving that persistence outlasts neglect.

climax.text: She showed that Black British women's stories belong at the center of world literature, not at its margins.

punchline.text: Eight books and decades of work led to one historic night.

quiz.question: What historic distinction did Evaristo achieve with the 2019 Booker Prize?
options: She was the youngest author ever to win the prize
She became the first Black woman to win the Booker Prize
She won for a debut novel
